Overall desired aspect 16:9; use generous high resolution. Thin white gutters separate every tile. The supplied 3 reference images correspond in order to the 3 rows. Each row has TWO genuinely different photographic variants of exactly the SAME scene and evidence, without changing scientific state, counts or quantities. Reinterpret the authored SVG references faithfully as REAL photographed equipment, physical classroom models and PRINTED physical evidence displays on cream or clear acrylic boards. Real camera optics, convincing material texture, soft natural or appropriate laboratory light. No flat SVG/cartoon appearance. Diagrams that cannot literally be photographed (atoms, particles, energy charts, reaction equations, spectra) must be presented as a clearly physical teaching model or printed card/monitor display in the photograph. A printed display can faithfully preserve reference geometry and lettering. IMPORTANT: If the reference has a graph, numerical table, radioactive isotope equation, particle-count model, paired temperatures or labeled apparatus, preserve the actual numbers, charge signs, ordering, arrows, relationships and counts; never fabricate a result, fill a question mark, or replace scientific evidence with a generic backdrop. No invented scale marks or numbers on glass or instruments. Do not copy the final all-caps footer, because the app displays it separately. Keep ALL essential apparatus and readable evidence inside each tile's central 88% width and central 75% height, with generous quiet margins, so cropping to a panoramic 1280x480 banner loses nothing. Use large legible printed text with ample spacing. No people, logos, watermarks or title outside the atlas. Never leak an adjacent tile into a photograph.
